The asparagus, mushrooms, rice and orange squash on the plate do not establish other named food categories. I considered every frozen definition; no other unresolved category ambiguity is visible.

The large vehicle along the left edge has the front and glazing of a bus, while a partial white passenger car is visible at right behind the horse. Horse tack and the riders' clothing do not identify a handbag or backpack. I considered every frozen definition; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

The tiny wheel/frame-like structure near the far-left background could be a bicycle but is too small to identify confidently, so bicycle is unclear.
